description: Configure the OpenVox package repository for this OS, removing the release packages of other OpenVox and Puppet major versions. With apt_base_url or yum_base_url, the release package comes from that mirror and its repository file is pointed at it

apt_base_url.description: Base URL of a mirror of apt.voxpupuli.org, with the same layout: the release package is downloaded from it, and the repository file points at it. Defaults to https://apt.voxpupuli.org

yum_base_url.description: Base URL of a mirror of yum.voxpupuli.org, with the same layout: the release package is downloaded from it, and the repository file points at it. Defaults to https://yum.voxpupuli.org
